label: Bible Study
prompt: For if our heart condemn us, God is _____ than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verse: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
note: When your own heart condemns you, God is greater — and he knows everything.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the _____.
verse: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
note: Meek isn't weak — Jesus promises the gentle the whole earth, echoing Psalm 37:11 from His mountainside sermon.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And why beholdest thou the _____ that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verse: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
note: Modern versions say speck; the KJV says mote — while you ignore the beam, a whole plank, in your own eye.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let the word of Christ dwell in you _____ in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
note: Paul's prescription for church music: let the word move in and teach through psalms, hymns and spiritual songs.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not _____ unto the heavenly vision:
verse: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
note: Paul before King Agrippa, summing up the Damascus road: 'I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision.'
